messages:
tara_cs: Flagging ZenithApps renewal (in 14 days). Procurement is balking at the +11% list increase. They asked if we can either do a temporary 9-month price lock at current rate or accept a PO at current price if submitted before month-end. Also asked about consolidated billing and whether we can backdate invoice to PO issue date.
ian_ae: Good catch. If we offer a 9mo bridge at current price we should put explicit language about price freeze and rollback to list after term. Can RevOps okay this?
revops-bot: RevOps policy: one-time 9-month price-protect amendment is allowed for strategic renewals if AE+CS secure exec-level email commitment and either (a) PO or (b) signed amendment within 30 days. CC fallback allowed for one invoice cycle. Revenue recognition requires signed docs within 45 days.
zoe_billing: For consolidated billing we need their selected billing entity and VAT IDs. If they want backdated invoicing to PO issue date we can accommodate only if PO clearly includes billing entity and vendor code. Preferred PO example:
```
PO: ZEN-2026-210
Vendor code: 77055-RW
Billing entity: Redwood Inc. (US)
Billing contact: acctspay@zenith.com
```
ed_legal: If we do an amendment, I'll draft a 2-paragraph addendum: 1) 9-month term dates and fixed pricing; 2) exception for tax/VAT adjustments. Also include a tie-breaker clause for PO acceptance: "Company will honor PO pricing if vendor code and PO are received before EOM; otherwise amendment applies." Any objections?
tara_cs: No SOW changes. Customer insists on price lock and wants the amendment to be signed or PO in-hand before month-end. Procurement warned vendor-code creation may take 7-12 days.
ian_ae: I'll push for exec email and PO today. If vendor-code delays, are we ok with CC fallback?
revops-bot: CC fallback approved for one invoice cycle only. AE must attach exec confirmation email thread to ticket and set collection milestones. Finance will not finalize committed revenue until PO or signed amendment is received.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope prepared: env-ZEN-210 (status: draft). Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/env-ZEN-210
zoe_billing: Small note: when drafting amendment please include a field "Billing entity (for invoice)" and "VAT ID (if EU)" so we can avoid rework. Also flag if they request consolidated invoice across subsidiaries.
ed_legal: Will include billing fields and a short VAT clause. Drafting now; ETA 6 hours.
tara_cs: Thanks. I'll chase procurement and post PO here when received. Will also capture exec email and upload to the ticket. :pray:
